intent: A menu surface: a dark, rounded container that holds MenuRow children with roving keyboard focus over its items. Pair with PopoverMenu for positioning.
use_when: The contents of a context / dropdown menu.
Grouping MenuRow items (with dividers and headings).
dont_use_when: A single inline control — use the control directly.
A full modal — use a dialog.

tokens.note: Renders dark (data-composa-mode=dark) so child tokens resolve to dark values.

a11y.items: roving focus over menuitem / menuitemradio / menuitemcheckbox children; Arrow / Home / End.
